propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered workflow on main saturates the Free plan's 20 concurrent job limit, causing runner queues up to 873 seconds during burst periods
The tickets branch has no workflows and generated zero Actions runs; existing premise attributing saturation to tickets-branch pushes is unsupported

Current Verified workflow generates 17 runner jobs per full-route run (up to 24 with mutation shards), with 13 jobs created simultaneously post-classification, creating immediate 13-job fan-out demand
